<prose>Jonah sits in the dark with his wife Mara, trying to resist a desire that feels so satisfying, so close. He knows the door separating him from Mara will never close again, and for a moment he forgets about the outside world, only her body and mind in his mind. But he keeps on trying, and even when their bodies collide, it makes him lose the sensation of Mara, and it gives a sharp pain in his lower back.</prose>
